description: This Java class 'ReadableOrderPopulator' is responsible for converting 'Order' model objects into 'ReadableOrder' data transfer objects, including mapping billing and delivery addresses and order totals.

classes.name: ReadableOrderPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates a ReadableOrder object from an Order object, including mapping addresses and order totals.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts an 'Order' object into a 'ReadableOrder', mapping essential order details, addresses, and totals.

methods.name: createTotal
methods.description: Creates and returns an 'OrderTotal' object for the 'ReadableOrder' based on 'OrderTotal' model.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Method overridden from AbstractDataPopulator, returning null as placeholder.
